summary: The gpu group is the user-space GPU stack for the Qualcomm Adreno GPU on device "eureka" (SoC SXR2230P, board platform anorak). It contains the EGL, OpenGL ES 1/2/3, Vulkan and OpenCL drivers and their Android loaders; the KGSL user-space library libgsl.so; the GpuService daemon and its library; an eBPF tracepoint program on gpu_mem/gpu_mem_total; ZAP, SQE and GMU firmware; six Vulkan/OpenGL ES feature permission XML files; and an Oculus IGpuControl 1.0 passthrough HAL on odm. Two PEM system CA certificates and libar-gsl.so (an audio Graph Service Layer library whose name collides with GSL) are in the group but are not GPU components. Init scripts, SELinux policy, the VINTF manifest and the msm_kgsl.ko kernel module (outside the group, vendor_dlkm_a) reference these files by path or name. All 67 rows were matched to recorded size and sha256. Commands in evidence are run from MNT=<image>/mnt unless an absolute path is shown. Helper scripts are in <image>-tools/work/subsystems/gpu/ (bpf_decode.py, zap_check.sh, zap_cert_probe.py, roles_map.py, roles_build.py).

claims.claim: The program reads three fields from the tracepoint context: u32 at offset 8, u32 at offset 12 and u64 at offset 16. It uses the key (u32 at +8) << 32 | (u32 at +12) and the value u64 at +16. A zero value deletes the key with helper 3. A non-zero value looks up the key with helper 1 and overwrites the stored value if found, or inserts it with helper 2 and flags 1 otherwise.
